notes.title: DeltaZeal V1.0.3 Update - New Replay Features
notes.notes:
[h1]DeltaZeal V1.03 - 12/15/2015[/h1]
[list][*]You can now record replay videos longer than 30 minutes (up to 60 minutes).
[*]Added a Fast Forward feature to replay playback.  Use the "X" button to toggle fast forward on and off.
[*]Corrected an error where the keyboard would start both P1 and P2 at the same time.
[*]Optimized text display so menus and leaderboards should be more responsive.
[*]Corrected an error that could occur when accessing an empty leaderboard.[/list]
